in_marathi.name: Sameeksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sameeksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sameeksha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sameeksha’, which means ‘insight’ or ‘intuition’. It refers to the ability to see beyond the surface and understand the deeper meaning of things. This name is often given to a child who is believed to possess a sharp intellect and a strong intuition.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'sam' meaning 'together' and 'drk' meaning 'to see'. The goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, is often depicted with the 'sameeksha' mudra, the gesture of seeing or contemplating.
